That breaks the reading order and splits the copy from its headline.

Best use of the banner: the headline is wide and dominant over two lines, and the product is clearly secondary. But the body copy is crammed into a ragged six-line column at the right edge, cut off from the headline. The small logo and badge float above the headline at arbitrary, unaligned positions, and the headline sits close to the bottom edge.

The body copy is tiny and borderline illegible, the logo is minuscule, and the NEW VIDEO badge crowds the top of the circle. The hierarchy survives, but the layout doesn't fit the banner format.
